mentions.name: Increader
mentions.description: An incremental reading platform that combines read-it-later functionality with annotations and spaced repetition. Supports web articles, EPUBs, PDFs, and RSS feeds, with many small features to remove distractions and keep readers focused.
mentions.problem: The builder wanted to test whether the idea of incremental reading has merit; it worked so well it became their main way of reading.
